name: Spectral-conversion film concept
description: A thin optical layer absorbs excitation and re-emits by a specified model.
scope: Native v2 appearance libraries store uniform PBR values. The GLB carries the richer authored portable material; new image maps are external runtime resources, not automatically installed in SolidCraft.
preview_scope: Actual SolidCraft GPU image; 64 samples, denoised. Read the receipt/variant; this is not a convergence or full-physics claim.
limitations: Illustrative authored RGB material; no measured optical/engineering certification.
Bump/height is not automatically geometric displacement.
Full original specification retained; generated realization is not every required physical capability.
Wave/spectral/time-dependent phenomenon is not simulated; static RGB authoring fallback and intended-model metadata are explicit.
